verdict.rationale: Xero has a built-in AI assistant called JAX that lets users delegate specific tasks — reconciling bank transactions, creating/editing/sending invoices via plain-language commands, and extracting bill details for approval — directly inside the product.  This matches the story of delegating tasks to a built-in assistant, but the evidence only covers a handful of discrete workflows rather than a general-purpose in-app agent, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of JAX's real-world reliability or scope.  Missing for 10: broader task coverage beyond invoicing/reconciliation/bills, independent user reviews or hands-on testing of JAX, and clarity on how conversational/agentic the assistant truly is.
